topics: Aggregate demand and its components
Average and marginal propensity to consume and to save
Short-run equilibrium output; investment multiplier and its mechanism

Excess and deficient demand; correction through government spending, taxes and money supply

chapters.name: Government Budget and the Economy

Revenue and capital receipts; revenue and capital expenditure
Balanced, surplus and deficit budget; measures of government deficit

chapters.name: Open Economy Macroeconomics
topics: Balance of payments account: meaning and components; surplus and deficit
Foreign exchange rate: fixed, flexible and managed floating
Determination of exchange rate in a free market; merits and demerits of flexible and fixed rates
